tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250cho ga'i sngon 'gro bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs las phyung ba ni/1$0000300

sngon 'gro thun mong las bdun te: dang po mtshams gcad pa ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du: snang srid rnam dag ye shes lha yi tshogs: kun bzang chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: rig rtsal rnam dag thabs shes g.yung drung lha: 'di la log par blta ba'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud sde dpung bcas thams cad phyir dengs shig: āoṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐: gṝhṇa gṝhṇa hūm̐: gṝhṇā pa ya gṝhṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga wān: bidyā rā tsa ya hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen khrag 'thung thugs ka nas: drag po'i byin rlabs mtshon cha'i 'od zer 'phro: mtshon cha'i gur chen ye shes me dpung 'bar: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kun nas khyab par srungs: āoṃ badzra tsakra tīgṇa karma kī la ya dzwa la raṃ: hūm̐: dregs pa lha chen phyogs skyong bsnol ba'i steng: che mchog la sogs dpal chen khro rgyal tshogs: gar dgu'i tshul gyis hūm̐ sgra sgrog cing bzhugs: bar chad 'byung po thams cad rdul du rlog: āoṃ badzra kro ta swa bhā wa: sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ bhi shwa tsakra dzwa la maṇḍa la ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭa: gnyis pa brda sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid thams cad bde chen gzhal yas khang: gzugs snang thams cad rang rig ye shes lha: de nyid ma rtogs rang rig sgo bcad pa: rang gsal ye shes 'char sgo da phyes shig: bhrūm̐ bhi shwa karma tsa tur pra we sha ya phaṭa: gsum pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung ye shes snying po sems kyi lha: ma rtogs rang ngo rang gis ma shes pa: ye nas rang dang 'grogs kyang zhal ma mthong: rang gsal brda yi don dam mjal phyag 'tshal: hūm̐ he ru ka a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: bzhi pa dam bca' ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: bskal pa sngon 'das dus nas yi dam lha: da lta gnyis med don dam rang bzhin shes: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bsgrub lags so:

hūm̐ badzra tsitta sa ma ya hūm̐: lnga pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes lnga yi pho brang nas: chos sku skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: longs sku rigs lnga zhi khro 'khor dang bcas: sprul sku yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig: khyed kyi thugs rje mchog gis rjes bzung nas: sgrub mchog bdag la byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: āoṃ shrī badzra kro ta dhe wa sarba duṣṭāṃ ḍā ki nī sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: ā we sha ya a ā: drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: rang dang gnyis med lha tshogs la: mar me sman gtor rakta dang: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul gyis bzhes: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra puṣpe hūm̐: zhes pa nas: badzra shabda hūm̐: badzra sarba pū dza me gha hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā bha liṃ ta te dzo bha liṃ ta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta sa manta maṇḍa la hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañtsa: ma hā bha liṃ ta: ma hā rakta: a ho su kha sa ma ya swā hā: bdun pa bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dgongs: bskal pa sngon 'das da lta'i dus yan chad: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag sogs: rang gnong 'gyod sems drag pos mthol zhing bshags: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: badzra sa ma ya dza: na ra ka: pre ta ka: tirya ka: ma nu she: dhe wa tri li bhi shuddhe: a li bhi shuddhe: dag sha ka shuddhe shuddhe swā hā: de yan chad ni sngon 'gro'i las rim rnams so:
